subject: Post-call recap: HealthSecure private / VPC options & next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Dana Harris <dana.harris@healthsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Private VPC options & next steps

Hi Dana (and John / security team),

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Data residency & regulatory requirement to keep PHI on-prem or within a dedicated VPC in our cloud region (no shared tenancy).
- Air-gap and egress restrictions for certain workloads (need ability to operate with restricted outbound connectivity / controlled update window).
- Network constraints: strict IP allowlists, mandatory proxy/firewall flows, and TLS inspection limitations.
- Compliance requirements: SOC 2 + additional controls around audit logs and key management (customer-managed KMS).

Goals you described:
- Pilot two use cases (PHI redaction pipeline + internal secure chat) by Q4 to validate latency/throughput and policy controls.
- Security review completed within 3 weeks, then infra validation and a small pilot.
- Clear handoff to your infra team to validate network and deployment model.

What Redwood can offer (recap):
- Private deployment options: VPC-hosted control plane with customer-managed network hooks, and on-prem air-gapped package for fully isolated environments.
- Support for customer KMS/HSM integrations, configurable egress policies, and IP range pinning for allowlists.
- Observability hooks for audit logs and token-level tracing that match compliance needs.

Requests / next steps:
1) Can you send a high-level network diagram + list of required outbound IP ranges and proxy requirements? (Marissa and I need this to map to our deployment pattern.)
2) Please confirm the security questionnaire deadline and whether an NDA/MOU is required ahead of sharing architecture diagrams.
3) Proposed follow-up: 30–45m call with your infra/security folks the week of Aug 24. I’ve penciled in Tue Aug 25 at 10:00am PT as an option — confirm if that works.

Attachments: redwood-private-overview.pdf (overview deck), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed timeline & owners).

Thanks again — happy to loop in our solutions architect if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Dana Harris <dana.harris@healthsecure.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@healthsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 18:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Private VPC options & next steps

Thanks Camila — really helpful recap and aligns with what we need. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do need the option for a fully isolated VPC (no shared tenancy). On-prem air-gap is desirable for the PHI redaction pipeline but we'll prioritize VPC first.
- Our security team requires FIPS-compliant crypto for the KMS endpoints and proof of how audit logs are retained and exported.
- For network constraints: our environment sits behind a proxy that performs TLS inspection; we’ll need the list of IP ranges and ports that Redwood will initiate connections from so our firewall team can whitelabel.

I've attached a high-level network diagram (healthsecure-network-diagram.pdf) that shows where the pilot services would sit. Our security review timeline is ~3 weeks starting today. We can share the full questionnaire if needed, but next steps from our side: give our infra team the IP allowlist and SAML metadata for SSO.

Proposed attendees for the follow-up call: myself, John Lee (infra), Priya Kapoor (security) — I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm a slot.

Thanks — Dana
Dana Harris
Director of IT Infrastructure
HealthSecure
